Campus Canteen Ordering System - Software Requirements
1. Introduction
Students now wait in long queues at the campus canteen during lunch breaks. This document describes a web app that lets them order and pay before they arrive.
2. Accounts
- Students shall sign up with their university email address.
- The system shall lock an account after 5 failed login attempts.
- A student session shall expire after 15 minutes of inactivity.
- Passwords must be stored as salted hashes.

3. Ordering
- Students shall browse the menu by category and see the price of each item.
- The system shall let a student place an order for pickup at a chosen time slot.
- A student may cancel an order within 10 minutes of placing it.
- The canteen staff shall see new orders on a dashboard within 5 seconds.
- The menu page should be user-friendly and load fast on mobile phones.

4. Payments
- The system shall accept payments through UPI using the payment gateway.
- Orders must not be sent to the kitchen until the payment is confirmed.
- The system should email a receipt to the student after each payment.
5. Policies
- An order shall only be cancelled within 5 minutes of placing it, and no refund is given after that.
- To keep the app secure, a student session shall expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.

6. Quality
- The system shall support 300 students ordering at the same time.
- The app shall be available 99.5% of the time during canteen hours.
- The system must comply with the university data protection policy.
- The system will keep order history for one academic year for reports.
7. Glossary
Time slot: a 15 minute pickup window.
